identity.retryPolicy: Transport failures (timeout (180s), network error, HTTP 408/409/429/5xx, unreadable API response with 5xx, incomplete or missing output) are retried up to 4 attempts per turn with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After and provider reset headers. Live calls use a 5-second minimum pace, increasing automatically to stay under 80% of a reported token/minute limit, and live episodes cool down by 30 seconds; every attempt and sanitized rate-limit header is recorded. Exhausted HTTP 429 retries interrupt the batch as infrastructure rather than counting as model failure. Invalid model output (unparseable JSON, schema violation, refusal) is not retried or repaired: it is recorded as an invalid response and terminates the episode as unsolved. A valid direction that is visibly blocked is not retried or repaired: it is executed as a blocked move, counts as a wall hit, consumes the turn, and the episode continues.

aiTransport.policy: Provider requests use the shared Vercel AI SDK transport with structured output. SDK retries are disabled; Echo Maze owns every retry, pacing delay, and attempt record.

identity.coordinateSystem: Walker-relative coordinates start at (0,0). A successful move right changes x by +1, left by -1, up by +1, down by -1. A blocked move changes nothing. The Walker never receives absolute maze rows/columns.
identity.hiddenStatePolicy: The prompt receives only the narrow observation DTO (open/blocked directions, corridor sightlines, per-visible-cell open directions and isExit flag, last action/result) plus the current run's conversation. No full maze, no exit coordinates, no seed, no optimal route, no unseen cells, and no spectator state may enter the prompt.

payload.notes: Start at (0,0). Open: down,left. Blocked: up,right. Sightline: down/left each lead to cell open up,right. Exit not visible. Exploring down first.

At (0,-1) after moving down from start. Open here: up,right. Blocked: down,left. Right sightline: dist1 cell open right,left; dist2 cell open up,left. So moving right path continues. Will explore right.
At (1,-1) after down then right. Open: right,left; blocked up,down. Left returns to (0,-1). Right leads to (2,-1), which opens up and back left, not exit. Continue exploring right.
At (2,-1). Arrived via right from (1,-1). Open: up,left. Left returns known path; up is unexplored. Choose up to explore new area.
At (2,0) after up from (2,-1). Open: right,down; blocked up,left. Right leads to (3,0) open down,left. Down returns to (2,-1). Left is blocked. Explore right to continue new territory.
At (3,0) after moving right from (2,0). Open down,left; blocked up,right. Left returns to (2,0). Down leads to (3,-1), which has open up,right; this is new territory. Exit not visible. Explore down.
At (3,-1) after moving down from (3,0). Open here: up,right. Up returns to known (3,0); right leads to new cell at distance 1 with open up/right/left. Continue exploring right toward new territory.

At (4,-1) after moving right from (3,-1). Open: up,right,left; down blocked. Right leads to dead-end cell open only left. Up leads to new cell (4,0) open right/down. Left returns to known (3,-1). Explore up.
At (4,0) after up from (4,-1). Open: right,down; blocked up,left. Down returns known (4,-1). Right sightline shows cell (5,0) open up,left, new territory. Explore right.
At (5,0) after moving right from (4,0). Open: up,left; blocked right,down. Left returns to known (4,0). Up leads to unexplored corridor with sightline depth 3, so explore up.

At (5,1) after up from (5,0). Open: up,down; blocked right,left. Down returns known (5,0). Up sightline depth 2 matches earlier: dist1 (5,2) open up,down,left; dist2 (5,3) open down,left. Dead-end corridor going up; continue up to explore.

At (5,2) after up from (5,1). Open: up, down, left; right blocked. Down returns known. Up leads to (5,3) open down/left. Left leads to new corridor: (4,2) open right/left, then (3,2) open up/right. Choose left to explore new territory with longer sightline.

At (4,2) after moving left from (5,2). Open: right,left; blocked up,down. Right returns to known (5,2). Left leads to new cell (3,2), which is open up and right, so unexplored upward. Choose left to continue exploring new territory.

At (3,2) after moving left from (4,2). Observation matches: open up/right, blocked down/left. Right returns to known corridor via (4,2)-(5,2). Up leads to new cell (3,3) with open down/left, so explore up to reach unexplored area.

Turn15 at (3,3) after up from (3,2). Open: down,left; blocked up,right. Down returns known (3,2). Left is new corridor depth3: (2,3) open R/L, (1,3) open R/L, (0,3) open R/down. Explore left into new territory.

Turn16 at (2,3) after left from (3,3). Open: right,left; blocked up,down. Matches corridor: (2,3) open R/L. Right returns known (3,3). Left sightline depth2: (1,3) open R/L, (0,3) open R/down. Continue left to reach (0,3) where down is unexplored.
Turn17 at (1,3): open R/L, blocked U/D. Left target (0,3) has open R/D, with unexplored down. Right leads back to known corridor toward (2,3)/(3,3). Move left to reach (0,3), then explore down.
Turn18 at (0,3): open right/down, blocked up/left. Right returns known corridor; down is unexplored. Choose down to continue.
Turn19 at (0,2) after down from (0,3). Open: up,left; blocked right,down. Up returns known (0,3). Left leads to new cell (-1,2) open up/right. Exit not visible. Move left to explore new territory.

Turn20 at (-1,2) after left from (0,2). Open: up,right; blocked down,left. Right returns to known (0,2). Up sightline shows (0,3) open U/D then (0,4) open D/L, so this upward path is unexplored above the known corridor. Explore up.
Turn21 at (-1,3) after up from (-1,2). Open up/down, blocked left/right. Down returns known (-1,2). Up leads to (-1,4), open down/left, unexplored. Continue up.

Turn22 at (-1,4) after up from (-1,3). Open: down,left; blocked up,right. Down returns known (-1,3). Left sightline depth2: (-2,4) open R/L, (-3,4) open U/R, unexplored. Exit not visible. Explore left.

Turn23 at (-2,4) after left from (-1,4). Open: right,left; blocked up,down. Right returns known (-1,4). Left leads to (-3,4) with open up,right, so unexplored upward path. Choose left to continue exploring new territory.
Turn24 at (-3,4) after left from (-2,4). Open up,right; down/left blocked. Right returns known (-2,4). Up leads to (-3,5) open up/right/down, then (-3,6) dead-end; explore up to access right branch.

Turn25 at (-3,5) after up from (-3,4). Open: up,right,down; left blocked. Up leads to dead-end (-3,6) open only down. Down returns known (-3,4). Right leads to (-2,5) open up/left, unexplored upward path. Explore right.
At (-2,5) after moving right from (-3,5). Open up/left; blocked right/down. Exit visible up 2 cells: (-2,6) then (-2,7) is exit. Move up toward exit.
At (-2,6). Up is open and sightline shows the cell one step up is the exit. Move up to reach exit.
